caseNameFull: Danielson v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Sidney B. Gambill for petitioners., Solicitor General Marshall and Assistant Attorney General Rogovin for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
